definition: Quack.com was an early voice portal company.
details: The domain name later was used for Quack, an iPad search application from AOL.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is Quack.com.
